ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..original: Ah, sorry, you're synthesizing? Oh, but that might actually be perfect...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..translation: Ах, извини, ты синтезируешь? Ох, но это может быть и вправду идеально...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..original: What? Perfect? Don't tell me, now that I'm vulnerable while synthesizing, that you're going to...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..translation: Что? Идеальный? Не говорите мне, что теперь, когда я уязвим во время синтеза, вы собираетесь...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..original: Where did that come from? We want to watch, Firis, and learn from you!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..translation: Откуда это взялось? Мы хотим наблюдать, Фирис, и учиться у тебя!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..original: What, that's all? You're welcome to do that! Watch all you like!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..translation: Что, это все? Вы можете это сделать! Смотрите все, что вам нравится!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..original: There, we're finished. What do you think of my synthesis?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..translation: Вот, мы закончили. Что вы думаете о моем синтезе?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..original: Wow. That's all I can say. You made that amazingly complex item without even hesitating!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..translation: Ух ты. Это все, что я могу сказать. Вы сделали этот удивительно сложный предмет, даже не раздумывая!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..original: Totally different from us. Why is that? The benefit of experience?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..translation: Совершенно отличается от нас. Почему это? Польза опыта?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..original: Maybe not... I've only been an alchemist for five years. I collected ores, when I was back home.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..translation: А может и нет... Я работаю алхимиком всего пять лет. Я собирал руду, когда вернулся домой.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..original: What?! Five years?! That's about the same as us! Firis, you've already taken the certification exam, right?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..translation: Что?! Пять лет?! Это примерно то же самое, что и мы! Фирис, ты уже сдал сертификационный экзамен, верно?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..original: Ah, that's right. I passed it about one year after I started. Haha!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..translation: Ах, это правда. Я прошел его примерно через год после того, как начал. Хаха!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..original: One year?... H-How did you manage that?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..translation: Один год?... К-как тебе это удалось?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..original: Well, I studied as I traveled, and resolved the problems of lots of different people, I guess?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..translation: Ну, я учился, путешествуя, и, наверное, решал проблемы множества разных людей?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..original: That doesn't sound like you did anything all that special?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..translation: Не похоже, что ты сделал что-то особенное?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..original: Uwah, I know you're a genius Firis, but this is still a bitter pill to swallow!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..translation: Ух, я знаю, что ты гений Фирис, но это все равно горькая пилюля, которую нужно проглотить!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..original: If only Dad had done a better job of teaching us! Gah. Sorry to have bothered you.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..translation: Если бы только папа лучше нас учил! Гах. Извините, что побеспокоил вас.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..original: Hey! You're leaving already? Hey, girls! Come on!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_010..translation: Привет! Ты уже уходишь? Эй, девочки! Ну давай же!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..original: Hey, girls. Can you tell me somewhere fun that's close to Merveille?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..translation: Привет, девочки. Можете ли вы рассказать мне о каких-нибудь развлечениях недалеко от Мервейля?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..original: Somewhere fun? What exactly do you want to do?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..translation: Где-нибудь весело? Что именно вы хотите сделать?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..original: Heheh, travel, just travel! My hobby is to visit all kinds of different places.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..translation: Хе-хе, путешествуйте, просто путешествуйте! Мое хобби – посещать самые разные места.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..original: Travel? In which case, there's a few good places.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..translation: Путешествовать? В этом случае есть несколько хороших мест.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..original: Hmmm, interesting! You are stirring up my curiosity now!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..translation: Хм, интересно! Вы сейчас возбуждаете мое любопытство!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..original: Uwah, I want to leave at once! I can't wait. But I've got jobs to finish first.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..translation: Увау, я хочу уйти немедленно! Я не могу ждать. Но мне нужно закончить работу в первую очередь.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..original: Hahaha! Firis, you really do love traveling!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Фирис, ты очень любишь путешествовать!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..original: Of course! Seeing the whole wide world has always been my dream!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..translation: Конечно! Увидеть весь мир всегда было моей мечтой!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..original: My home is a pretty unique place. I couldn't even leave it until I was around the age you are now.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..translation: Мой дом – довольно уникальное место. Я даже не мог оставить это, пока не достиг того возраста, в котором ты сейчас.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..original: Yep. I wanted to, but I couldn't. When I finally did, it was so much better than I imagined!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..translation: Ага. Я хотел, но не смог. Когда я наконец это сделал, это было намного лучше, чем я себе представлял!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..original: The wide sky, the soothing wind. The relaxing smell of grass, and land as far as I could see!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..translation: Широкое небо, успокаивающий ветер. Расслабляющий запах травы и земли, насколько я мог видеть!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..original: I just loved being outside, you know? And that love has never left me.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..translation: Мне просто нравилось находиться на улице, понимаешь? И эта любовь никогда не покидала меня.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..original: I see. So come on, Firis! Will you tell us more about your travels?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..translation: Я понимаю. Так что давай, Фирис! Расскажете подробнее о своих путешествиях?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..original: Yeah, good idea! We've never traveled ourselves, but we've always wanted to.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..translation: Да, хорошая идея! Мы никогда не путешествовали сами, но всегда хотели.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..original: Leave it to me, then! I'll talk until you're sick of hearing my voice!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..translation: Тогда оставьте это мне! Я буду говорить до тех пор, пока тебе не надоест слушать мой голос!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..original: Where to start, then? The thing about the outside world...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_020..translation: С чего же начать? Что касается внешнего мира...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: What are you talking about? That was just you, hahaha!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: О чем ты говоришь? Это был только ты, ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: Hah, not at all! Your teeth were chattering out of your head!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: Ха, совсем нет! Зубы стучали из головы!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: Ah, Ilmeria! Of course, you're friends, aren't you?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: Ах, Ильмерия! Конечно, вы друзья, не так ли?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: Hahah, mere friendship can't define our bond. We are both best friends and eternal rivals!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: Ха-ха, простая дружба не может определить нашу связь. Мы оба лучшие друзья и вечные соперники!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: Enough with the corny lines. Although I'm not denying it.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: Хватит банальных строк. Хотя я этого не отрицаю.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: If I resist she gets all annoying. I've known her a long time, so I understand her well.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: Если я сопротивляюсь, она начинает меня раздражать. Я ее давно знаю, поэтому хорошо ее понимаю.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: Heh. So you are good friends, in the end.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: Хех. Так что в конце концов вы хорошие друзья.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: Fated ones, perhaps. Hey, that reminds me! I do have one bone to pick with you!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: Судьбоносные, возможно. Эй, это напоминает мне! У меня есть с тобой одна кость!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: Ah! I think I know what you're going to say...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: Ах! Кажется, я знаю, что ты собираешься сказать...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: I bet you do! Why are you so big?!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: Могу поспорить, что да! Почему ты такой большой?!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: No, I won't! You've gotten taller and... bigger, too! I'd like a bit of that myself!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: Нет, я не буду! Ты стал выше и... больше! Я бы хотел немного этого сам!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: Oh dear... Well, it's hard not to notice the difference...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: О боже... Ну, трудно не заметить разницу...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: Ahahaha, not at all. You've grown up plenty, Il!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: Ахахаха, совсем нет. Ты уже повзрослел, Ил!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: I don't need your pity. I'm leaving! Bye!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: Мне не нужна твоя жалость. Я ухожу! Пока!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: She just stormed off... Are you alright with this, Firis?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: Она просто убежала... Ты не против, Фирис?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: Yeah, why not. This is pretty much how things always go down.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: Да, почему бы и нет. Примерно так всегда идут дела.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..original: I do wonder, though, Il. Have you really forgiven me?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_030..translation: Хотя мне интересно, Ил. Ты правда меня простил?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Oh, that's Firis. I wonder what she's talking to him about?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: О, это Фирис. Интересно, о чем она с ним говорит?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Here is the item you requested. I hope it is satisfactory.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Вот предмет, который вы просили. Я надеюсь, что это удовлетворительно.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: unknown(name_id=31)
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Yes, this is just what I needed! Thanks! Thank you!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Да, это как раз то, что мне нужно! Спасибо! Спасибо!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Looks like it was a job. She looked really mature there, too, didn't she?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Похоже, это была работа. Там она тоже выглядела очень зрелой, не так ли?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Yeah. She's not like that when talking to us, but she's formal and proper when she has to be.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Ага. Она не такая, когда разговаривает с нами, но она формальна и корректна, когда это необходимо.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Right then. Now my work's finished. Time to head to the bar!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Прямо тогда. Теперь моя работа закончена. Пора идти в бар!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Going to a bar after work! Wow, that's some more adult points right there!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: После работы иду в бар! Ого, вот это еще несколько взрослых моментов!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: You said it! The only question now is what will she order? Let's follow!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Ты сказал это! Вопрос теперь только в том, что она закажет? Давайте следовать!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Barkeep! Give me my usual!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Бармен! Дайте мне мой обычный!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: That's it! "My usual"! The second highest rated thing one wants to say once they're an adult!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Вот и все! «Мой обычный»! Вторая по рейтингу вещь, которую человек хочет сказать, когда станет взрослым!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Firis is incredible! I wonder what her "usual" is?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Фирис бесподобен! Интересно, что у нее «обычное»?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Master
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Thank you for waiting. Here's your rabbit steak, extra large portion!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Спасибо за ожидание. Вот ваш стейк из кролика, очень большая порция!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Wow, it looks delicious again today! Thank you!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Ого, сегодня снова вкусно! Спасибо!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: What? S-Steak? And look how much!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Что? С-стейк? И посмотрите, сколько!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: I'm starving. Time to tuck in! Ah, so lovely! I'm so happy. I think my tongue might melt!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Я умираю с голоду. Время пристегиваться! Ах, так мило! Я так счастлив. Я думаю, мой язык может расплавиться!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Ah, Firis, you're so cute! I could watch you eat all day long!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Ах, Фирис, ты такая милая! Я мог бы смотреть, как ты ешь, целый день!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Uwah, Liane! H-How long have you been here?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Ух ты, Лиана! Х-Как долго ты здесь?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Heheh. Wherever you go, Firis, I'll be there!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Хехех. Куда бы ты ни пошел, Фирис, я буду там!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: I'm not really sure what's going on, but that's some incredible confidence...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Я не совсем понимаю, что происходит, но это какая-то невероятная уверенность...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: That was delicious. Well, I think I need to get back. That was a great snack!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Это было восхитительно. Ну, думаю, мне пора возвращаться. Это была отличная закуска!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: A s-snack? That was a snack?! Wow, kiss those adult points goodbye, Firis!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Закуска? Это была закуска?! Ух ты, поцелуй эти взрослые очки на прощание, Фирис!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Maybe not. Eating that meat is how she avoids exhaustion, I bet!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Может быть, нет. Держу пари, что употребление этого мяса помогает ей избежать истощения!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Y-Yes, maybe! In which case, I guess Firis is mature after all!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Д-да, возможно! В таком случае, я думаю, Фирис все-таки взрослая!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Firis? Mature? For me she'll always be a child though, I think...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Фирис? Зрелый? Хотя для меня она всегда будет ребенком, я думаю...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: I guess she looks mature from your perspective, then. Hehe, I'm lucky to be her big sister!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Думаю, с твоей точки зрения, она выглядит зрелой. Хе-хе, мне повезло быть ее старшей сестрой!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..speaker: System
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..original: Firis has acquired the skill <CLEG>"Very Healthy Body"<CLNR>.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_040..translation: Фирис приобрела навык <CLEG> «Очень здоровое тело»<CLNR>.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..original: Hey, girls. Do you want to go hunting? Let's go hunting!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..translation: Привет, девочки. Хотите пойти на охоту? Поехали на охоту!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..original: Hunting? You mean, like, hunting animals?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..translation: Охота? Ты имеешь в виду охоту на животных?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..original: Yes. You've never hunted before, right? It could be a good experience for you.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..translation: Да. Ты никогда раньше не охотился, верно? Это может стать для вас хорошим опытом.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..original: Ah, I see. Yes, I've been wanting to try it!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..translation: Ах, я вижу. Да, я давно хотел попробовать!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..original: Me too. We always said we'd be able to save some money if we could hunt.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..translation: Я тоже. Мы всегда говорили, что сможем сэкономить немного денег, если научимся охотиться.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..original: Hahaha, that settles it then. Let's catch something big and eat a lovely meal!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..translation: Ха-ха-ха, тогда все решено. Давайте поймаем что-нибудь большое и съедим вкусную еду!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..original: Liane has told me a good place to go. Once you're ready, we'll head right out!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_050..translation: Лиана подсказала мне хорошее место, куда можно пойти. Как только вы будете готовы, мы сразу же отправимся!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_060..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_060..original: There we go. That one looks just right.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_060..translation: Вот и все. Вот этот выглядит как раз.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_060..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_060..original: Yeah... My palms are sweating. Firis, how do we hunt it?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_060..translation: Да... У меня потеют ладони. Фирис, как нам на него охотиться?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_060..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_060..original: What do you mean, how? Just like usual. We fight and defeat it! That's all!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_060..translation: Что ты имеешь в виду, как? Как обычно. Мы боремся и побеждаем его! Вот и все!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_060..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_060..original: Hold on? You call that hunting?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_060..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_060..original: Yes, I do! It's a bit different after defeating it, anyway. Come on, both of you!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_060..translation: Да! В любом случае, после победы над ним все немного по-другому. Давайте оба!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_070..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_070..original: This one is tougher than I expected. But I won't lose! I need meat!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_070..translation: Этот сложнее, чем я ожидал. Но я не проиграю! Мне нужно мясо!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: Good, we got it! Now, what's different after we defeat it?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..translation: Хорошо, мы поняли! А что изменится после того, как мы его победим?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: We have to skin it, and drain the blood. If it's too much for you, you don't have to...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..translation: Нам нужно снять с него шкуру и слить кровь. Если для тебя это слишком много, не надо...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: No, it's okay... This is part of the hunt. If we are taking a life, we have to see this through.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..translation: Нет, все в порядке... Это часть охоты. Если мы лишаем жизни человека, мы должны довести это до конца.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: Hehe, all right. Here we go, then.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: Yes, a good hunt! We have to process the meat to preserve it.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..translation: Да, удачной охоты! Нам приходится обрабатывать мясо, чтобы сохранить его.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: Please do! I can't wait to eat it!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..translation: Пожалуйста, сделайте! Не могу дождаться, чтобы съесть это!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: Thank you for bringing us out with you today. We learned a lot!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..translation: Спасибо, что пригласили нас сегодня с собой. Мы многому научились!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: You are quite incredible with that bow, too, Firis!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..translation: Ты тоже потрясающе владеешь этим луком, Фирис!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: Tell me about it! I've never seen an alchemist who can use a bow so well!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..translation: Расскажи мне об этом! Я никогда не видел алхимика, который так хорошо владел бы луком!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: Ah, well. I learnt hunting and shooting from Liane. I was fighting with a staff before that.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..translation: Ах, ну. Я научился охоте и стрельбе у Лианы. До этого я ругался с посохом.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: Liane looked so cool using a bow. I twisted her arm until she taught me.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..translation: Лиана выглядела так круто, используя лук. Я выкручивал ей руку, пока она меня не научила.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: Wow, so you haven't been using the bow all that long? You really are amazing, Firis!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..translation: Ого, так ты не так уж долго пользовался луком? Ты действительно потрясающая, Фирис!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: Learning both archery and alchemy so quickly. You're just so talented!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..translation: Так быстро научился стрельбе из лука и алхимии. Ты просто такой талантливый!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: S-Sorry, I admit that I'm cheating a little! Unaided I might hit one in one hundred!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..translation: П-Извините, признаю, что немного жульничаю! Без посторонней помощи я мог бы поразить одного из ста!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: I use alchemy to make the arrows chase the prey. Hahaha!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..translation: Я использую алхимию, чтобы заставить стрелы преследовать добычу. Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: That's impressive too, actually! Using alchemy to do that!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..translation: На самом деле это тоже впечатляет! Используйте для этого алхимию!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..original: You said it. You're a genius, Firis, no doubt about it.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_080..translation: Ты сказал это. Ты гений, Фирис, в этом нет никаких сомнений.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: Hey, girls! The meat is ready now! You want some, right?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Эй, девочки! Мясо уже готово! Ты хочешь немного, да?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: Yes, please! I was just starting to feel hungry!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Да, пожалуйста! Я только начал чувствовать голод!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: Sounds good. I'll give you the full banquet.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Звучит отлично. Я устрою тебе полный банкет.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: Hahah! Leave this to your head chef!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Ха-ха! Оставьте это своему шеф-повару!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: First, chop this... oww, not my finger! Next, roast this... ugah, flambé!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Сначала отрежь вот это... ой, не мой палец! Затем поджарьте это... ух, фламбе!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: Firis! You don't really cook much... Don't push it and let me...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Фирис! Ты на самом деле мало готовишь... Не напрягайся и позволь мне...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: I'm fine, honest. Go over there, Liane! I want to cook for the twins.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Я в порядке, честно. Иди туда, Лиана! Я хочу приготовить для близнецов.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: That was great! Wow, I'm stuffed.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Это было здорово! Вау, я наелся.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: It was so good. The kitchen is in chaos, but we can ignore that.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Это было так хорошо. На кухне царит хаос, но мы можем игнорировать это.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: Hahaha, I should have practiced a bit more first. At least it turned out alright.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Ха-ха-ха, мне надо было сначала еще немного потренироваться. По крайней мере, все оказалось в порядке.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: I was surprised, though, to learn you don't like veggies, Firis.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Однако я был удивлен, узнав, что ты не любишь овощи, Фирис.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: What? T-That's not true!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Что? Т-это неправда!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: You can't hide it from me. I saw you avoiding them!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Ты не сможешь скрыть это от меня. Я видел, как ты избегал их!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: It's always been that way. Firis just won't eat her greens, no matter what I say...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Так было всегда. Фирис просто не будет есть свою зелень, что бы я ни говорил...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: Hey. It's their fault for never changing! They're bitter and stringy and horrible!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Привет. Это их вина, что они никогда не менялись! Они горькие, тягучие и ужасные!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: You'll let down your fans talking like that. "Mature" Firis!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Вы подведете своих фанатов, говоря такие слова. «Зрелая» Фирис!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: What? Mature? I'm the one over here always worrying that I'm too immature!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Что? Зрелый? Это я здесь всегда беспокоюсь, что я слишком незрелый!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: Ah, thinking that Firis is an adult was just our mistake. Sorry about that.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Ах, думать, что Фирис взрослая, было нашей ошибкой. Извините за это.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: Sorry? Why are you apologizing? I'm getting confused again!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Извини? Почему ты извиняешься? Я снова запутался!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: Uwah, well, there are some things you only find out once you get close to someone, right?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Ух, ну, есть вещи, которые узнаешь только тогда, когда сблизишься с кем-то, верно?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: Lydie. That makes absolutely no sense in this context.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Лиди. В данном контексте это не имеет абсолютно никакого смысла.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: Hahaha! You're right. Some things you only find out once you get to know someone.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Ты прав. Некоторые вещи узнаешь только тогда, когда узнаешь кого-то поближе.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: So I want to become better and better friends with you both, and learn all about you.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Поэтому я хочу подружиться с вами обоими все лучше и лучше и узнать о вас все.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: Us too!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Мы тоже!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: Very well. One day I'll make you realize that I actually am an adult. You'll see!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Очень хорошо. Однажды я заставлю тебя осознать, что я на самом деле взрослый человек. Вы увидите!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..speaker: Liane
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..original: Firis. Comments like that are no way to prove anything.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_090..translation: Фирис. Подобные комментарии ничего не доказывают.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: Hey, Ilmeria, how are your folks doing?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Привет, Ильмерия, как поживают твои родители?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: Ah, not too bad. They keep saying they want to come by, it's a little annoying.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Ах, не так уж и плохо. Они продолжают говорить, что хотят зайти, это немного раздражает.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: Hold on! Ilmeria, you're here again? You don't live here, do you?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Подожди! Ильмерия, ты снова здесь? Ты не живешь здесь, не так ли?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: Of course not! I just find looking at Firis' vacant face the perfect way to unwind!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Конечно, нет! Я просто считаю, что взгляд на пустое лицо Фирис — идеальный способ расслабиться!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: Wah! That was a nasty thing to just come out and say. Why do you have to pick on me like that?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Вау! Было противно просто так выйти и сказать это. Почему ты так ко мне придираешься?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: Hahaha, the two of you are such good friends. I bet having a best friend is great.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Ха-ха-ха, вы двое такие хорошие друзья. Могу поспорить, иметь лучшего друга – это здорово.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: Hehe. Having friends you can rely on is important. That's some advice from your teacher.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Хе-хе. Очень важно иметь друзей, на которых можно положиться. Это совет вашего учителя.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: Teacher? That reminds me, I haven't heard the details, but you two are Ilmeria's students? Haha!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Учитель? Это напомнило мне, я не слышал подробностей, но вы двое — ученики Ильмерии? Хаха!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: S-She's laughing at us! Is there something wrong with that?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Т-Она смеётся над нами! Что-то в этом не так?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: Nope, exactly the opposite. If Ilmeria is teaching you, you're sure to become incredible alchemists.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Нет, ровно наоборот. Если Ильмерия будет вас учить, вы обязательно станете невероятными алхимиками.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: You bet. They're the students of the greatest genius super-wonderful alchemist of our times!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Держу пари. Они ученики величайшего гениального супер-замечательного алхимика нашего времени!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: Hearing that puts a lot of pressure on us... We'll do our best to meet your expectations...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Услышав это, мы оказываемся под большим давлением... Мы сделаем все возможное, чтобы оправдать ваши ожидания...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: Thank you. At least try to avoid becoming like Firis, always getting jobs wrong!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Спасибо. По крайней мере, постарайтесь не стать похожим на Фириса, который всегда неправильно выполняет работу!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: What? She's done that?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Что? Она это сделала?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: We used to have an atelier together. Once, she mixed up bombs and gun powder. Wow, it was bad.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: У нас вместе было ателье. Однажды она перепутала бомбы и порох. Вау, это было плохо.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: I'm more surprised to hear you had an atelier together, actually!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Вообще-то, я еще больше удивлен, узнав, что у вас есть совместное ателье!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: Me too! Why don't you still work together?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Я тоже! Почему вы до сих пор не работаете вместе?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: That's...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Это...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: A secret, girls! Come on, let's have some tea.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Секрет, девочки! Давай, выпьем чаю.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: Lydie, Sue. Help me make it. You are not going to leave all the work to your teacher, are you?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Лиди, Сью. Помогите мне сделать это. Вы же не собираетесь оставлять всю работу учителю, не так ли?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: Of course not! We're coming!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Конечно, нет! Мы идем!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..original: Oh, Il...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_100..translation: Ох, Иль...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: Ilmeria? Not really sure how to say this...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Ильмерия? Не совсем уверен, как это сказать...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: Haha, you've given yourselves away already. This is about Firis, right?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Хаха, ты уже себя выдал. Речь идет о Фирис, да?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: Yes. We really want to know why you stopped running an atelier together.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Да. Мы очень хотим знать, почему вы вместе перестали управлять ателье.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: It's nothing too major, believe me. You know how she likes to travel, right?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Ничего особенного, поверьте мне. Ты же знаешь, как она любит путешествовать, да?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: Yes. It's always been her dream, hasn't it?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Да. Это всегда было ее мечтой, не так ли?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: That's right, all the way back to when she was little.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Верно, еще в те времена, когда она была маленькой.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: Even when we had our atelier, I would see her looking sadly out of the window.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Даже когда у нас было свое ателье, я видел, как она грустно смотрит в окно.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: So I told her that she should go and travel. That's all.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Поэтому я сказал ей, что ей следует отправиться в путешествие. Вот и все.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: I see. So you went your separate ways.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Я понимаю. Итак, вы пошли разными путями.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: That's right. I don't want to travel, I want to run an atelier.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Это верно. Я не хочу путешествовать, я хочу открыть ателье.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: Taking travel away from Firis would be like clipping a bird's wings, so this is fine by me.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Уехать от Фириса было бы все равно, что подрезать птице крылья, так что меня это устраивает.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: You stay out of this, though, girls. That's an order from your teacher.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Но вы держитесь подальше от этого, девочки. Это приказ твоего учителя.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: All right. Thank you for telling us.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Все в порядке. Спасибо, что рассказали нам.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: Hehehe, so that's the story! Looking into this a bit more might reveal all sorts of juicy...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Хе-хе-хе, вот в чем история! Если разобраться в этом подробнее, возможно, откроются самые разные пикантные вещи...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: Sue? Do you want to feel the full power of my wrath? You'll be ashes in seconds, of course!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Сью? Хочешь ощутить всю силу моего гнева? Конечно, через несколько секунд ты превратишься в пепел!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: Uwah! I was joking, just a silly joke! Hahaha!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Ува! Я пошутил, просто глупая шутка! Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..original: Sure it was. Unlike me, though, it still seems to weigh on her mind a bit, which does worry me.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_110..translation: Конечно, это было так. Однако, в отличие от меня, это, кажется, все еще немного тяготит ее разум, и это меня беспокоит.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..original: Hey, it's Firis. Is she out shopping?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..translation: Привет, это Фирис. Она ходит по магазинам?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..original: Just a little more! 850! Please? Come on!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..translation: Еще немного! 850! Пожалуйста? Ну давай же!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: Peddler
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..original: Okay, okay! I can't resist your passion!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..translation: Хорошо, хорошо! Я не могу устоять перед твоей страстью!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: Peddler
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..original: Here you go, 850 Coll. No one else is going to buy this, anyway. Go ahead!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..translation: Вот, 850 кол. Все равно никто это покупать не будет. Вперед, продолжать!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..original: That was some vicious bartering right there, Firis.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..translation: Это был какой-то порочный бартер, Фирис.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..original: Haha, you saw that? Something I was taught. The best way to make a purchase is with a discount!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..translation: Хаха, ты это видел? Кое-чему меня научили. Лучший способ совершить покупку – со скидкой!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..original: Y-Your methods seem a bit rough, though! What were you buying, anyway?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..translation: Т-хотя твои методы кажутся немного грубыми! Что ты вообще покупал?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..original: Hahaha! A really, really cute toy.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..original: Cute? I want to see it! Can I take a look?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..translation: Милый? Я хочу это увидеть! Могу ли я взглянуть?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..original: Hmmm. Alright. Just for you, Sue. Ta-dah!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..translation: Хм. Хорошо. Только для тебя, Сью. Та-да!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..translation: ... Вау. Разве ты не сказал о-мило?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..original: Sure did! I've loved this character for ages. I buy one whenever I see it!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..translation: Конечно, сделал! Я люблю этого персонажа уже много лет. Я покупаю его каждый раз, когда вижу!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..original: Heheh, those big round eyes and vivid colors. So charming! I can't take my eyes off it!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..translation: Хехех, эти большие круглые глаза и яркие цвета. Такой очаровательный! Я не могу отвести от этого глаз!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..original: Hahaha. I think Firis' views on cuteness...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..translation: Ха-ха-ха. Я думаю, взгляды Фирис на привлекательность...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..original: Yeah. They're a bit different from ours.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..translation: Ага. Они немного отличаются от наших.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..original: Right! Your name is "Googly No. 6"! Come on, let's get home and take a nap, Googly!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..translation: Верно! Вас зовут «Гугли №6»! Давай, пойдем домой и вздремнем, Гугли!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..speaker: System
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_120..original: Firis has acquired the skill <CLEG>"Carefree Girl"<CLNR>.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: Huh? Girls, you look a bit tired.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: Хм? Девочки, вы выглядите немного уставшей.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: Ah, you noticed? We've just been so busy with work.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: Ах, вы заметили? Мы просто были так заняты работой.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: Hmm, we can't have that. Let's take a break! I know just the thing.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: Хм, мы не можем этого допустить. Давайте сделаем перерыв! Я знаю только это.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: Here it is! A card game that Liane got for me. Let's play this together.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: Вот! Карточная игра, которую Лиана подарила мне. Давайте поиграем в это вместе.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: Sure, we can do that, but Lydie'll need her usual handicap.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: Конечно, мы можем это сделать, но Лиди понадобится ее обычный недостаток.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: Sure, fine. I'm feeling lucky today, so a pretty heavy one might be a good idea.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: Конечно, хорошо. Мне сегодня повезло, так что довольно тяжелый вариант может быть хорошей идеей.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: Ah, I win! Royal Geshpenst Finish!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: Ах, я выиграл! Королевский Гешпенст Финиш!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: Yes, I win again! Super Extreme Straight Nova!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: Да, я снова выиграл! Супер-экстремальная прямая Нова!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: Hehe, I win again! Ultra Imperial Destiny Full House!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: Хе-хе, я снова выиграл! Ультра Императорская Судьба Аншлаг!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: T-This is impossible! You never see those hands, ever!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: Т-это невозможно! Вы никогда не увидите этих рук!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: Uwah! Lydie is impossibly lucky. There's no way to beat her in games that involve chance.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: Ува! Лиди невероятно повезло. Ее невозможно победить в азартных играх.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: Ah, so that's why there's a handicap!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: А, так вот почему тут инвалид!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: Bah, this is boring! Lydie, you're just too good!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: Ба, это скучно! Лиди, ты слишком хороша!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: I do see where you're coming from, but I can't exactly hold back, can I?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: Я понимаю, откуда ты идешь, но я не могу сдержаться, не так ли?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: Hahaha. Sounds like it's time to test a medicine I thought up a while back. Bring me these materials here!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: Ха-ха-ха. Похоже, пришло время протестировать лекарство, которое я придумал некоторое время назад. Принесите мне эти материалы сюда!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: What? Sure, we can, but just what are you trying to make?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: Что? Конечно, можем, но что вы пытаетесь сделать?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..original: You'll see once it's ready. I'm counting on you!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_130..translation: Вы увидите, как только он будет готов. Я рассчитываю на тебя!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..original: Firis. We've got the stuff you asked for.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..translation: Фирис. У нас есть то, что вы просили.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..original: Ah, thanks. This is just what I need. Let's synthesize at once!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..translation: Ах, спасибо. Это как раз то, что мне нужно. Давайте сразу синтезировать!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..original: It's done! Drinking this will give you incredible luck. I call it the Beckoner of Luck!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..translation: Готово! Выпив это, вы получите невероятную удачу. Я называю это Призывателем Удачи!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..original: Luck...?! Putting the silly name aside, if that works then it will be incredible.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..translation: Удача...?! Если оставить в стороне глупое название, если это сработает, то это будет невероятно.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..original: I know! Go ahead, Sue, take a swig!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..translation: Я знаю! Давай, Сью, сделай глоток!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..original: Roger that, Professor Firis! With this, I can beat even Lydie!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..translation: Вот это, профессор Фирис! С этим я смогу победить даже Лиди!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..original: Wow, it tastes good too! It feels like my whole body is brimming with luck!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..translation: Вау, это тоже вкусно! Такое ощущение, что все мое тело наполнено удачей!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..original: Right! Time for some revenge, Lydie!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..original: Ah, I'm not sure what to say... Sorry? I guess I shouldn't have won?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..translation: Ах, я не знаю, что сказать... Извините? Полагаю, я не должен был выигрывать?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..original: I definitely was luckier than before... And all the hands I wouldn't get before were turning up...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..translation: Мне определенно повезло больше, чем раньше... И все руки, которые мне не удавалось получить раньше, выпадали...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..original: But she always had better... We've been completely defeated.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..translation: Но ей всегда было лучше... Мы потерпели полное поражение.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..original: Ah! I hate this heavy atmosphere!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..original: Firis. There are just some things even alchemy cannot overcome.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..translation: Фирис. Есть вещи, которые не под силу преодолеть даже алхимии.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..original: I guess so, although I'd rather not have learned that. Lydie's luck really is incredible.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..translation: Наверное, да, хотя мне бы не хотелось этого знать. Удача Лиди действительно невероятна.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..original: I said that I'm sorry! Forgive me, please!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_140..translation: Я сказал, что мне очень жаль! Простите меня, пожалуйста!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: La la la! I found some buried treasure!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Ла-ла-ла! Я нашел зарытый клад!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: Firis! Are you back from a trip somewhere?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Фирис! Вы вернулись из поездки куда-нибудь?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: No, not quite. I was investigating some ruins nearby.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Нет, не совсем. Я исследовал какие-то руины неподалеку.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: Investigating ruins! You're pulling our legs. You're no archeologist!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Исследование руин! Ты тянешь нас за ноги. Ты не археолог!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: I'm serious! Here, as proof, I found this rare item!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Я серьезно! Вот, в доказательство, я нашел этот редкий предмет!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: Wow, what is that? A fragment of something?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Вау, что это? Фрагмент чего-то?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: I reckon it's a piece of a weapon, from maybe 200 years ago. There're markings on it here.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Я считаю, что это часть оружия, изготовленного, может быть, 200 лет назад. Здесь есть маркировка.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: You really do sound like an archeologist! Firis, seriously, just what are you?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Вы действительно похожи на археолога! Фирис, серьезно, ты кто?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: That's rude! I'm an alchemist! Someone I used to travel with just taught me some things about history.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Это грубо! Я алхимик! Кто-то, с кем я путешествовал, только что научил меня кое-чему из истории.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: So I got attracted to it too. Sometimes I even go to investigate ruins now!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Так что меня это тоже привлекло. Иногда я даже сейчас хожу исследовать руины!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: Wow. Maybe it would be faster if we just asked you what you can't do?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Ух ты. Может, было бы быстрее, если бы мы просто спросили тебя, чего ты делать не умеешь?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: Hahaha, this is just me copying someone else, really. Here, you can have this for your alchemy.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Ха-ха-ха, это я просто копирую кого-то другого, правда. Вот, ты можешь взять это для своей алхимии.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: T-Thanks! Isn't this important, though? An archeological find?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Т-Спасибо! Разве это не важно? Археологическая находка?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: Don't worry. I found it nearby, so I don't think it's cursed much...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Не волнуйся. Я нашел его неподалеку, так что не думаю, что он сильно проклят...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: That's not really what I was asking, but alright... If it was just nearby, it should be okay.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: На самом деле я не об этом спрашивал, но ладно... Если бы это было где-то рядом, все было бы в порядке.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: Right, you two, see you later! I'm off to make something exciting!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Хорошо, вы двое, увидимся позже! Я собираюсь сделать что-то интересное!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: She doesn't think it's cursed much... That means it might be a little bit?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Она не думает, что оно сильно проклято... Значит, может быть, немного?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: Hahaha, Sue, we can't worry about that. Right?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Ха-ха-ха, Сью, нам не стоит об этом беспокоиться. Верно?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: System
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: <CLEG>Golden Tree Leaf<CLNR> and <CLEG>Golden Threads<CLNR> received.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: <CLEG>Золотой лист дерева<CLNR> и <CLEG>Золотые нити<CLNR> получены.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..speaker: System
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..original: Firis has acquired the skill <CLEG>"My Sister's Bow"<CLNR>.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_150..translation: Фирис приобрела навык <CLEG> «Лук моей сестры» <CLNR>.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..original: Thank you so much! You make the play so much more vibrant, Firis!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..translation: Большое спасибо! Ты делаешь пьесу намного ярче, Фирис!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..original: Yes. Most impressive, Firis. You've completely mastered all those techniques I taught you.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..translation: Да. Самое впечатляющее, Фирис. Ты полностью освоил все те техники, которым я тебя научил.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..original: Really? It's been a while, so I was pretty nervous!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..translation: Действительно? Прошло много времени, поэтому я очень нервничал!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..original: Wow, this is a rare combination. Have you been watching a play, Firis?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..translation: Ого, это редкое сочетание. Ты смотрела спектакль, Фирис?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..original: No, she wasn't. She was performing in one, actually!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..translation: Нет, она не была. На самом деле она выступала в одном из них!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..original: Yeah. I've traveled with Drossel and Fritz in the past. Quite a lot happened then, too.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..translation: Ага. Раньше я путешествовал с Дросселем и Фрицем. Тогда тоже многое произошло.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..original: Firis is a pretty skilled performer! She puts a lot of energy into her script.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..translation: Фирис - довольно умелый исполнитель! Она вкладывает много энергии в свой сценарий.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..original: Hahaha, thank you for saying that! I'd better get going, anyway.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..translation: Ха-ха-ха, спасибо, что сказал это! В любом случае, мне лучше идти.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..speaker: Drossel
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..original: Of course. Liane will be worried if you don't get back soon.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..translation: Конечно. Лиана будет волноваться, если ты не вернешься в ближайшее время.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..speaker: Fritz
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..original: That was a great performance today, Firis. See you again!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..translation: Сегодня было великолепное выступление, Фирис. Увидимся снова!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..original: I can't believe the number of hobbies Firis has. Hunting, archeology, puppet theatre!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..translation: Я не могу поверить, сколько хобби есть у Фирис. Охота, археология, кукольный театр!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..original: Like I said, we should get her to list up the stuff she can't do. She's a great alchemist, too!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..translation: Как я уже сказал, мы должны заставить ее составить список вещей, которые она не может делать. Она еще и великий алхимик!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..original: Uwah! I might be about to turn green with envy. Do you think she's using alchemy to control time?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..translation: Ува! Возможно, я позеленею от зависти. Думаешь, она использует алхимию, чтобы управлять временем?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..original: Hahaha, I'm not sure it's anything that extreme. But there still might be some secret to it...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..translation: Ха-ха-ха, я не уверен, что это что-то настолько экстремальное. Но, возможно, в этом есть какой-то секрет...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..original: Humm. How about just asking Firis straight out?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..translation: Хм. Как насчет того, чтобы прямо спросить Фирис?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..original: Yeah, that does seem like the fastest way. Let's find out how she can do all this stuff!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_160..translation: Да, кажется, это самый быстрый способ. Давайте узнаем, как она может все это делать!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: Firis, Firis, Firis! F I R I S!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Фирис, Фирис, Фирис! Ф И Р И С!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: Uwah, what's up? You're completely hyper today, aren't you?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Увау, что случилось? Ты сегодня совершенно возбужден, не так ли?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: We've got something to ask you! You can do all sorts of stuff, right?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Нам есть что вас спросить! Вы можете делать все что угодно, верно?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: We were wondering if there's a reason for that... some kind of secret to your success?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Нам интересно, есть ли для этого причина... какой-то секрет вашего успеха?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: Nope, no secret. I just like trying all sorts of things.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Нет, никакого секрета. Мне просто нравится пробовать все подряд.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: I like traveling, right? And during those travels, I've been taught things by all these different people.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Мне нравится путешествовать, правда? И во время этих путешествий меня учили разные люди.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: I see. So you picked this stuff up as you traveled around!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Я понимаю. Итак, вы подобрали этот материал во время путешествия!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: Yes! The me you see before you was made with help of many different of people. I'm very grateful to them all!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Да! Тот «я», которого вы видите перед собой, был создан с помощью множества разных людей. Я им всем очень благодарен!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: Sorry, did that come off too patronizing?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Простите, это показалось слишком покровительственным?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: No, not at all! Hey, Sue. Maybe we should head out and travel a bit too?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Нет, совсем нет! Привет, Сью. Может, нам тоже стоит отправиться в путешествие?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: Yes! Get a bit more experience of the world. I'd like to learn to play a musical instrument.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Да! Получите немного больше опыта в мире. Я хотел бы научиться играть на музыкальном инструменте.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: Haha, that would suit you, Sue! I'd like to make some beautiful clothes.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Ха-ха, тебе бы это подошло, Сью! Я хочу сшить красивую одежду.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: Head out into the world and I'm sure you'll be able to learn both of those things.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Отправляйтесь в мир, и я уверен, что вы сможете научиться обеим этим вещам.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: It's a big place out there, after all! You can do pretty much anything you set your mind to!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: В конце концов, это большое место! Вы можете сделать практически все, что захотите!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: Gah! Lydie! I just want to head out there right away!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Га! Лиди! Я просто хочу отправиться туда прямо сейчас!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: Wow, Sue! Me too, I guess!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Вау, Сью! Я тоже, наверное!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: But first we need to become the greatest atelier in the kingdom, don't we?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Но сначала нам нужно стать величайшим ателье королевства, не так ли?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: OK. I know! Let's buy some travel guidebooks! That should make us feel like we've taken a trip!
