ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: ХОРОШО. Я знаю! Давайте купим путеводители! Это должно заставить нас почувствовать, что мы отправились в путешествие!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: Great idea! Let's go to the bookstore at once. Firis, thanks for talking to us!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Отличная идея! Давай сразу сходим в книжный магазин. Фирис, спасибо, что поговорили с нами!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..original: Their eyes were really sparkling! I wonder if that's what I looked like?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_170..translation: Их глаза действительно сверкали! Интересно, я так выглядел?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Firis, can you share some more tales from your travels with us?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Фирис, можешь ли ты поделиться с нами еще какими-нибудь историями из своих путешествий?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: We've been holding it in, but these guidebooks just don't work any more!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Мы сдерживались, но эти путеводители больше не работают!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Hahah, I'm happy to talk as much as you like. I love chatting about this stuff!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Ха-ха, я рад говорить столько, сколько тебе хочется. Я люблю болтать об этом!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Great! I should have known, Firis. No more time to waste, then!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Большой! Я должен был знать, Фирис. Тогда больше нечего терять времени!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Which story next, then? How about the time I went to some flying islands in an airship?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Какая же история следующая? А как насчет того случая, когда я отправился на летающие острова на дирижабле?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Or when I fought that bone monster in those ruins? Or when that big monster almost carried me off!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Или когда я сражался с тем костяным монстром в тех руинах? Или когда тот большой монстр чуть не унес меня!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Uwah! They all sound great, I can't choose!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Ува! Все звучат великолепно, я не могу выбрать!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: I'll just tell them in order, then. First, the airship...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Тогда я просто расскажу им по порядку. Во-первых, дирижабль...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: And so, barely defeating Ilmeria, I had to fight Miss Sophie for the final exam!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: И вот, едва победив Ильмерию, мне пришлось сразиться с Мисс Софи на выпускном экзамене!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: On the next episode of Firis, Burning Alchemist! "The Final Battle, Teacher and Student!"
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: В следующем выпуске «Фирис, Пылающий Алхимик!» «Последняя битва, учитель и ученик!»

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Uwah! Not sure where the episodic format came from, but you've lived quite a wild life!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Ува! Не знаю, откуда взялся эпизодический формат, но вы прожили довольно разгульную жизнь!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Tell me about it. I've read novels with less twists and turns, Firis!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Расскажи мне об этом. Я читал романы с меньшими перипетиями, Фирис!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: These are my treasured memories, after all. I'll never forget any of them, as long as I live.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: В конце концов, это мои драгоценные воспоминания. Я никогда не забуду ни одного из них, пока я жив.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Treasures! I love the sound of that! We need to travel and get some treasures of our own!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Сокровища! Мне нравится это звучание! Нам нужно путешествовать и добывать собственные сокровища!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Right! Loads of them!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Верно! Их очень много!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Hehe. That's it for today, anyway. I've kept you too long already. Come again any time, though.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Хе-хе. Во всяком случае, на сегодня это всё. Я уже слишком долго держал тебя. Впрочем, приходите снова в любое время.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Great, I can't wait. Let's get going, Lydie!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Отлично, не могу дождаться. Поехали, Лиди!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Wait for me, Sue! We need to get home and start making our own travel plans!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Подожди меня, Сью! Нам нужно вернуться домой и начать строить собственные планы путешествий!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: Lydie, Sue. I can't wait to hear the stories of your own adventures.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Лиди, Сью. Мне не терпится услышать истории о твоих приключениях.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..speaker: System
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..original: A new Combination Art for Sue and Firis <CLEG>"Firis and Sue Surprise"<CLNR> is unlocked.<CR>
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_180..translation: Разблокировано новое комбинированное искусство для Сью и Фирис <CLEG> «Сюрприз Фирис и Сью»<CLNR>.<CR>

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Firis, was that a sigh? Is something wrong? Are you hungry?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Фирис, это был вздох? Что-то не так? Вы голодны?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Or some meat you were looking forward to eating has been eaten by someone else?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Или мясо, которое вы так хотели съесть, было съедено кем-то другим?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: All I think about is food, is that it? Thanks.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Все, о чем я думаю, это еда, не так ли? Спасибо.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: I wasn't thinking about my next meal, actually, but about Ilmeria.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: На самом деле я думал не о следующем обеде, а об Ильмерии.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Ilmeria? You mean, about the atelier you used to run together?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Ильмерия? Ты имеешь в виду ателье, которым вы вместе управляли?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Yeah. She's the one who invited me to join her.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Ага. Это она пригласила меня присоединиться к ней.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: But then I headed off alone on my travels, betraying her.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Но затем я отправился один в свое путешествие, предав ее.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: She told me it was okay, but I still feel guilty...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Она сказала мне, что все в порядке, но я все еще чувствую себя виноватым...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: She's not bothered by it at all. She told us! Told us she was happy you went traveling.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Ее это совершенно не беспокоит. Она рассказала нам! Сказала нам, что она рада, что ты отправился в путешествие.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Come on, you know Ilmeria. She isn't always honest about her feelings, even with herself.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Да ладно, ты же знаешь Ильмерию. Она не всегда честна в своих чувствах, даже перед самой собой.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Someone else isn't being honest about feelings here! You should ask her, if it bothers you that much!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Кто-то здесь нечестен в своих чувствах! Спроси у нее, если тебя это так беспокоит!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Sitting around worrying isn't like you, Firis. Bring back some of that Firis energy!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Сидеть и беспокоиться – это не похоже на тебя, Фирис. Верните себе немного энергии Фирис!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Girls. You're right, of course. All right!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Девушки. Вы правы, конечно. Все в порядке!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: I'm going to go and ask Il, straight up, what she thinks of me.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Я пойду и прямо спрошу Иль, что она думает обо мне.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Good, that's the way. I'm sure it will turn out fine.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Хорошо, вот так. Я уверен, что все будет хорошо.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..original: Thank you! Right, I just need to maintain my resolve!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_190..translation: Спасибо! Да, мне просто нужно сохранять решимость!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Stay calm, stay calm. I need to do this. I'm just going to find out the truth, that's all.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Сохраняйте спокойствие, сохраняйте спокойствие. Мне нужно это сделать. Я просто собираюсь узнать правду, вот и все.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Hey, it's Firis. She looks a bit nervous...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Привет, это Фирис. Она выглядит немного нервной...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Very well. Time for us to step in.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Очень хорошо. Нам пора вмешаться.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Hey, Firis! What a surprise, running into you here!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Привет, Фирис! Какой сюрприз, встретить тебя здесь!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: We were just going to see our teacher. Why don't you come along with us?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Мы просто собирались увидеться с нашим учителем. Почему бы тебе не пойти с нами?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Uwah, hold on! Hey, don't drag me!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Увау, держись! Эй, не тащи меня!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Ah, hello you three. You've become quite close, haven't you all?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Ах, привет вам троим. Вы стали довольно близки, не так ли?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: It's nothing like that. In this case, anyway. Firis was waiting outside the atelier.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Ничего подобного. Во всяком случае в этом случае. Фирис ждала возле ателье.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Ehehe. Firis. There's something you want to ask Ilmeria, isn't there?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Эхехе. Фирис. Ты хочешь кое-что спросить у Ильмерии, не так ли?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Ugwah, you're ganging up on me! Fine, fine!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Ухва, вы на меня нападаете! Хорошо, хорошо!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Ilmeria! Be honest. Aren't you angry that I left the atelier and went off on my own?!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Ильмерия! Будьте честны. Ты не злишься, что я ушел из ателье и ушел один?!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Not really?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Не совсем?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: That was quick! You don't think I was selfish? Leaving you like that?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Это было быстро! Ты не думаешь, что я был эгоистом? Оставить тебя вот так?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: No, I don't. Like I've already told those two, I'm not bothered at all.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Нет, я не знаю. Как я уже сказал этим двоим, меня это совершенно не беспокоит.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: You are freedom personified. Like a tuna, unable to stay in one place.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Вы — олицетворение свободы. Как тунец, неспособный оставаться на одном месте.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: A t-tuna? I admit I can't settle down, but still, I'm not a fish!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Т-тунец? Признаю, что не могу остепениться, но все же я не рыба!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Also, I think you need to do something with your habit to overthink something all on your own.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Кроме того, я думаю, вам нужно что-то делать со своей привычкой думать о чем-то самостоятельно.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: You get so serious about the strangest things. Can't you just be carefree all the time?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Ты так серьезно относишься к самым странным вещам. Разве ты не можешь все время быть беззаботным?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: You think so? Hahaha, I guess I did it again! Hehehe!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Вы так думаете? Ха-ха-ха, кажется, я сделал это снова! Хе-хе-хе!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: That Puni-like smile, that's it. That's the Firis I want to see.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Эта улыбка Пуни, вот и все. Это тот Фирис, которого я хочу увидеть.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: But wherever you go, and whatever you see, in the end make sure you come back to me.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Но куда бы ты ни пошел и что бы ты ни увидел, в конце концов обязательно вернись ко мне.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: I haven't given up on running an atelier with you, yet, either.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Я еще не отказался от совместного с тобой ателье.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Okay. I can make that promise. I'll come back and see you, when I'm ready.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Хорошо. Я могу дать это обещание. Я вернусь и увидимся, когда буду готов.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Just wait until then, Il!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Просто подожди до тех пор, Ил!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: I think that takes care of that?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Я думаю, это позаботится об этом?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: I think so. Hehe, I'm glad.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Я так думаю. Хе-хе, я рад.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..speaker: System
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..original: Firis has acquired the skill <CLEG>"Wealth of Experience"<CLNR>.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_200..translation: Фирис приобрела навык <CLEG> «Богатство опыта»<CLNR>.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Hmm, what else do I need? I need some more rations, and a blanket too.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Хм, что еще мне нужно? Мне нужны еще пайки и одеяло.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Rations? Are you planning some kind of trip?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Ah, yeah. I've seen Sophie and the others here. I'm going to leave Merveille, for a while.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Ах, да. Я видел здесь Софи и остальных. Я собираюсь на время покинуть Мервейль.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Of course... You're a tuna, after all, Firis.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Конечно... Ты же все-таки тунец, Фирис.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Stop calling me a fish! Uwah, now I feel all smelly!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Перестань называть меня рыбой! Увау, теперь я чувствую весь вонючий запах!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Wow, so you're leaving, Firis... Any idea where you are going?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Ух ты, так ты уходишь, Фирис... Есть идеи, куда ты направляешься?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: No, I haven't decided. I'm just going to see where my feet take me.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Нет, я не решил. Я просто посмотрю, куда поведут меня мои ноги.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: But I've decided on a plan. I'm going to repay my debts to everyone!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Но я определился с планом. Я отдам долг всем!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Just like before, I'm going to study all sorts of things as I travel.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Как и раньше, я буду изучать разные вещи во время путешествий.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Then I'm going to use the things I've learned to help all the people who've helped me!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Затем я собираюсь использовать то, чему научился, чтобы помочь всем людям, которые помогли мне!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: That's how I'm going to repay them all. A bit vague, perhaps, but that suits my style!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Вот как я собираюсь отплатить им всем. Возможно, немного расплывчато, но это соответствует моему стилю!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Yes, it's just like you, Firis!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Да, это так же, как ты, Фирис!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: A kind and fine goal to have. We'll be behind you all the way, Firis.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Добрая и прекрасная цель. Мы будем позади тебя всю дорогу, Фирис.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Hehe, thanks. That really gets me fired up to do this!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Хе-хе, спасибо. Это действительно вдохновляет меня сделать это!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..original: Right! You just wait for me, world! I'm going to repay everyone who's been kind to me! Hahaha!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_210..translation: Верно! Ты просто жди меня, мир! Я отплачу всем, кто был добр ко мне! Ха-ха-ха!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..original: Hey, girls. There's something I want to talk to you about.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..translation: Привет, девочки. Есть кое-что, о чем я хочу с тобой поговорить.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..original: I want to give something as a gift to everyone who has helped me around here.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..translation: Я хочу подарить что-нибудь каждому, кто мне здесь помогал.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..original: I've got something for most people, but I've gone a bit overboard on my gift for Ilmeria.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..translation: У меня есть что-то для большинства людей, но я немного переборщил с подарком для Ильмерии.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..original: Let me guess. You've run out of materials?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..translation: Позвольте мне угадать. У вас закончились материалы?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..original: Yes, that's right. I'm sorry, but could you help me with the synthesis?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..translation: Да, это так. Извините, но не могли бы вы помочь мне с синтезом?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..original: No trouble at all! Hehe! A good chance to show you our progress, too!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..translation: Никаких проблем! Хе-хе! Хороший шанс показать вам наш прогресс!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..original: Ah, bold words! I've got this note here with everything I need.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..translation: Ах, смелые слова! У меня есть эта записка со всем, что мне нужно.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..original: Lydie, Sue. I'll be counting on you!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_220..translation: Лиди, Сью. Я буду рассчитывать на тебя!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Here you go, Firis. We've made the items you wanted.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Вот, Фирис. Мы изготовили то, что вы хотели.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Thanks! Yes, these look very well made.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Спасибо! Да, они выглядят очень хорошо сделанными.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Right, now it's my turn! I'll synth this up in a moment, just hold on.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Отлично, теперь моя очередь! Я сейчас это синтезирую, просто подожди.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Great! We'll watch and get some tips!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Большой! Посмотрим и получим несколько советов!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: It's done! This is what I'm going to give to Ilmeria!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Готово! Вот что я подарю Ильмерии!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Hold on, Firis. What is this?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Подожди, Фирис. Что это?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: I'll explain later. I have to get this to her at once!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Я объясню позже. Я должен передать это ей немедленно!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Here you are again. What is it this time?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Вот и ты снова. Что на этот раз?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Hehehe! I've got a present for you today!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Хе-хе-хе! У меня сегодня для тебя подарок!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Here you are. A thank you for everything you do for me!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Вот, пожалуйста. Спасибо тебе за все, что ты для меня делаешь!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: What is this? Some kind of item for bending space?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Что это? Какой-то предмет для искривления пространства?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: That's right, Il! It's a tool that lets you move freely between two points.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Правильно, Ил! Это инструмент, который позволяет вам свободно перемещаться между двумя точками.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Two points? Which means...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Два балла? Что означает...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: I can move freely between your atelier and mine?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Я могу свободно перемещаться между вашим ателье и моим?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: That's right. We can meet up whenever we like!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Это верно. Мы можем встретиться, когда захотим!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: This is proof of my promise to come back to you. Will you accept it?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Это доказательство моего обещания вернуться к вам. Вы примете это?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Wow. You made this crazy item just to keep your promise? You dummy! You super dummy!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Ух ты. Ты сделал эту сумасшедшую вещь только для того, чтобы сдержать свое обещание? Ты дурак! Ты супер дурачок!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Hey, don't call me dummy! It wasn't easy to think this up, you know!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Эй, не называй меня дураком! Знаете, нелегко было это придумать!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: I know. Thank you, Firis. The strength of your feelings have reached me.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Я знаю. Спасибо, Фирис. Сила твоих чувств достигла меня.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Remember this, though. With this item I can now visit your atelier at any time.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Однако помните об этом. С этим предметом я теперь могу посещать ваше ателье в любое время.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: If you take too long coming back, I'll be over to bother you every day!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Если ты будешь слишком долго возвращаться, я буду приходить и беспокоить тебя каждый день!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Hahaha, I'll keep that in mind! We'll be friends forever, Il!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Ха-ха-ха, я буду иметь это в виду! Мы будем друзьями навсегда, Ил!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: We certainly will, if I have anything to say about it.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Мы обязательно это сделаем, если мне есть что сказать по этому поводу.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Sue. Sue! Let's leave them too it.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Сью. Сью! Оставим и им это.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..original: Yeah, we should. I hope you two are very happy together!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_230..translation: Да, мы должны. Я надеюсь, что вы двое очень счастливы вместе!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Lydie! Sue! I'm coming in!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Лиди! Сью! Я вхожу!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Hey, Firis. Ah, I see! You've come to get revenge on Lydie at cards!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Привет, Фирис. Ах, я вижу! Вы пришли отомстить Лиди в карты!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Ah, that is tempting, but that's not why I'm here. I've got a gift for both of you, too!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Ах, это заманчиво, но я здесь не поэтому. У меня тоже есть подарок для вас обоих!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: What? You made gifts for us too?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Что? Вы тоже сделали нам подарки?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Of course! You've helped me a lot, too. Just this gift almost isn't enough!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Конечно! Ты мне тоже очень помог. Просто этого подарка почти недостаточно!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: I really wanted to let you know how grateful I am. So, without further delay, here you go!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Я действительно хотел, чтобы вы знали, как я благодарен. Итак, без дальнейших проволочек, вперед!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: It's got wings on it? So this is the same as your tent, Firis?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: У него есть крылья? Так это то же самое, что и твоя палатка, Фирис?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Yes. It's a winged, portable atelier! It's basically the same as my own atelier!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Да. Это крылатое, портативное ателье! По сути, это то же самое, что и мое собственное ателье!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Those wings are really great. It will fly to wherever you need it!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Эти крылья действительно великолепны. Он полетит туда, куда вам нужно!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Wow. I've given up being amazed by how amazing you are, Firis.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Ух ты. Я уже перестал удивляться тому, какая ты замечательная, Фирис.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Me too! Hahaha! Thank you so much for this gift.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Я тоже! Ха-ха-ха! Большое спасибо за этот подарок.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: You seemed keen on doing some traveling, so I thought of something to help you out. That's all.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Похоже, ты очень хотел путешествовать, поэтому я подумал, чем бы тебе помочь. Вот и все.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Traveling is great! It's fun, and you learn so much. I really want you both to try it.
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Путешествовать – это здорово! Это весело, и ты многому учишься. Я очень хочу, чтобы вы оба попробовали это.

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: You'll make a load of new discoveries if you do. Hahaha! The world is just so large, after all!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Если вы это сделаете, вы сделаете массу новых открытий. Ха-ха-ха! В конце концов, мир такой большой!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: OK! Hey, Sue, if we are going to travel, where do you want to go?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: ХОРОШО! Привет, Сью, если мы собираемся путешествовать, куда ты хочешь поехать?

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Good question. An island? Ooh, a quiet forest!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Хороший вопрос. Остров? Ох, тихий лес!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Ah, I can't pick just one place! I want to see loads of different places!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Ох, я не могу выбрать только одно место! Я хочу увидеть много разных мест!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Well said! Me too. So let's really push the boat out...
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Хорошо сказано! Я тоже. Итак, давайте действительно вытолкнем лодку...

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: Hmmmm, seeing them have so much fun is making me itch to get back on the road, too!
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Хмммм, видя, как они так весело проводят время, мне тоже не терпится снова отправиться в путь!

ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..speaker: Firis
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..original: North, south, or maybe west! Which way should I head next?
ebm:qc02_fir/event_message_qc02_fir_240..translation: Север, юг или, может быть, запад! В какую сторону мне идти дальше?
